[NCBK.12.3] Each callback area registers through its own `ds_engine_set_<area>_callback`, named in that area's clause and declared in `runtime/include/libds.h`. The setters are not enumerated here; a second copy of the header's own list drifts and nothing reconciles it.

One area departs from the pattern. Cache persistence ([NCBK.7]) registers both
callbacks in one call, `ds_engine_cache_callbacks`, rather than one setter each.
